factual_claims.source_evidence: One of the key efficiency indicators, aircraft load factor, increased by 1.5 percentage points in 2025 to 97.2 percent, compared with 95.7 percent in 2024.

factual_claims.claim: Additionally, early sales showed positive trends, with bookings for the 2026 summer season reaching levels 59 percent higher by December 2025 compared to the previous year.
factual_claims.label: SUPPORTED
factual_claims.source_evidence: By December 2025, bookings for the 2026 summer season were 59 percent higher than in the previous year.

factual_claims.claim: Results were partially constrained during the autumn season by market-wide supply increases exerting price pressure and by disruptions at Vilnius Airport related to illegal cross-border activity involving unmanned balloons, which reduced last-minute travel demand.
factual_claims.label: SUPPORTED
factual_claims.source_evidence: In addition, disruptions at Vilnius Airport related to illegal cross-border activity involving unmanned balloons reduced last-minute travel demand... the increase in market-wide supply during the autumn season put pressure on prices.
